pages.title: Here, There, Somewhere
pages.text: Relocate yourself successfully using a native teleportation spell.

pages.title: Here, There, Somewhere
pages.text: Use magic for a practical journey; the reward supports further experiments without granting a transport artifact.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Choose a native self-teleportation spell in your book or scroll and a valid destination. Credit follows the actual safe teleport, not the start of casting.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Teleport resolves its own valid destination, dismounts passengers and resets fall distance; it is not a map-waypoint teleport.
